components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action within a local decision area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--emerald-deep, #085239); border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--emerald, #0B6E4F), var(--emerald-deep, #085239)); color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .35px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A compact secondary action that stays subordinate to the primary task.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #C6CFDC); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink-soft, #42536C); font: 600 13px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); background: var(--emerald-soft, #E4F1EB); color: var(--emerald-deep, #085239); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: #d8ebe2; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A small categorical filter with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--indigo, #3D4E8F); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--indigo-soft, #E7EAF6); color: var(--indigo, #3D4E8F); font: 600 10.5px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(.98); } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #3D4E8F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Question Card
components.description: The core study unit, combining status, question hierarchy, and a restrained expanded state.
components.html:
Q-042 · REVIEW

How does an API gateway enforce identity at the edge?

Frame the trust boundary, token validation, propagation, and failure behavior.
components.css: .ds-question { padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #DBE1EA); border-left: 3px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #14233A); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,35,58,.05), 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(20,35,58,.28)); } .ds-question-meta { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--emerald-deep, #085239); font: 600 10.5px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; } .ds-question-title { margin: 0; font: 600 19px/1.25 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-question-body { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #42536C); font: 400 14px/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-question:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Note Input
components.description: A quiet long-form field for rehearsal notes and evidence.
components.html: <label class="ds-note-label" for="ds-note">YOUR NOTES</label><textarea class="ds-note" id="ds-note" rows="3" placeholder="Write the trade-off in your own words…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-note-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--ink-soft, #42536C); font: 600 10.5px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; } .ds-note { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 88px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #DBE1EA); border-radius: 9px; background: #FCFDFE; color: var(--ink, #14233A); font: 400 14px/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-note:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #C6CFDC); } .ds-note:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--emerald-soft, #E4F1EB); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A persistent current-location cue with icon, label, and structural active edge.
components.html: Question Bank
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 10px 9px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #DBE1EA); border-left: 3px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--emerald-soft, #E4F1EB); color: var(--emerald-deep, #085239); font: 600 14px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { border-color: var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); } .ds-nav-item:active { background: #d8ebe2; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Result
components.description: A keyboard-navigable result row that makes source and match context easy to scan.
components.html: SYSTEM DESIGNAPI gateway identity at the edgeAuthentication · authorization · token propagation
components.css: .ds-search-result { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #14233A); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-search-kind { color: var(--indigo, #3D4E8F); font: 600 10.5px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .5px; } .ds-search-title { font: 600 15px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search-copy { color: var(--muted, #626E7F); font: 400 13px/1.45 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search-result:hover { border-color: var(--line, #DBE1EA); background: var(--paper, #EEF1F6); } .ds-search-result:active { background: var(--indigo-soft, #E7EAF6); } .ds-search-result:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #3D4E8F); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Calendar Day
components.description: A compact scheduling cell that shares GAZLL states while supporting denser operational information.
components.css: .ds-calendar-day { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 7px 8px; min-width: 128px; min-height: 92px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #14233A); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-calendar-number { font: 600 15px/1.2 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-calendar-event { align-self: end; color: var(--ink-soft, #42536C); font: 500 12px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-calendar-status { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; align-self: start; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); color: #fff; font: 600 9px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .4px; } .ds-calendar-day:hover { background: var(--emerald-soft, #E4F1EB); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,35,58,.05), 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(20,35,58,.28)); } .ds-calendar-day:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-calendar-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--emerald, #0B6E4F); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
GAZLL should feel like The Systems Lab Notebook: a calm, rigorous workspace where a senior backend engineer collects evidence, rehearses explanations, and returns to difficult ideas. It is closer to a carefully annotated technical reference than a promotional learning product. The interface should reward depth without becoming heavy, and remain easy to scan during focused study.

The visual system is built around cool paper, crisp white work surfaces, deep navy text, and restrained engineering accents. Its voice is precise rather than sterile: compact metadata, visible structure, quiet feedback, and enough warmth to make repeated study inviting.

The calendar-schedule subtool uses the same materials—color, type, controls, focus treatment, and radii—but a denser operational topology. It may use month, year, agenda, rail, and item views without copying the main study page composition. This is shared materials, different instrument, not a separate brand.
keyCharacteristics: Precise controls over cool paper and crisp work surfaces.
One visual language across study and scheduling tools.

rules.name: The Accent Means Meaning Rule
rules.body: Accent colors communicate interaction, completion, status, or a stable content family. Do not use them as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Soft Before Solid Rule
rules.body: Prefer a pale wash for broad areas and reserve saturated fills for primary actions, small selected states, and high-salience markers such as today. Never place long body copy on a saturated accent.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Space Grotesk to orient, IBM Plex Sans to explain, and IBM Plex Mono to annotate. Do not use mono for paragraphs or Space Grotesk for dense answer text.

rules.name: The 600 Is Bold Rule
rules.body: The downloaded families make weight 600 the dependable bold UI weight. Avoid synthesized weights. Use 700 only where the loaded Space Grotesk face and hierarchy genuinely require it.

rules.name: The One Shell Rule
rules.body: Header, navigation, and main content share the same horizontal anchors even when their internal grids differ. Alignment should make the interface feel authored before decoration is added.

rules.name: The Shed, Don’t Wrap Rule
rules.body: The persistent header remains one row. At 999px, 760px, 600px, and 420px, remove or relocate lower-priority controls before allowing the header to wrap. Preserve the current task, language, search, and navigation access according to context.

rules.name: The Line-First Rule
rules.body: Add a border or tonal step before adding a shadow. The default surface shadow is subtle. Stronger ambient shadows belong only to overlays, modals, active expandable cards, and temporarily raised interactions.

rules.name: The Purposeful Pill Rule
rules.body: 999px is for tags, filters, statuses, and compact segmented actions only. Content cards, dialogs, text fields, and calendar cells retain visible corners.

rules.name: The Control Is a Control Rule
rules.body: Clickable behavior must use a real button, link, input, or appropriate interactive element. Preserve keyboard order, visible focus, at least 44px touch targets where feasible, and explicit accessible names for icon-only actions.

dos: Do make evidence, progress, and next action legible at a glance.
Do preserve EN/VI parity and allow labels and headings to expand without clipping.
Do use whitespace, alignment, borders, and typographic contrast before adding decoration.
Do keep calendar-schedule recognizably GAZLL while optimizing its denser workflow independently.
Do verify focus, hover, active, disabled, empty, loading, error, and reduced-motion states.
donts: Don’t turn every card, heading, or icon into a different accent color.
Don’t stack shadows on ordinary nested surfaces or make the notebook feel like a floating-card dashboard.
Don’t hide essential actions behind hover-only affordances or use color as the sole state signal.
Don’t introduce new font families, arbitrary radii, or one-off spacing when an existing token fits.
Don’t force the calendar into the study page layout; share the design language, not the exact composition.
